name: @dsh-agent/dsh-agent-memory
description: Agent-facing memory layer (increment 1, I1 foundation + I1.2 scoring calibration): four narrow tools (remember/recall/expand/prune) over a human-readable NDJSON store with a fail-closed write protocol, atomic writes, hard caps with score-based eviction, and zero runtime dependencies. I1.2 scoring: BM25 with per-field statistics, absolute-scale display (no batch normalization), VCP-style tag coverage as a diagnostic column, and MMR diversity multiplied into the printed score.

scripts.test: node test/protocol.test.mjs && node test/cap.test.mjs && node test/pure.test.mjs && node test/scoring.test.mjs && node test/recall.test.mjs && node test/lossless.test.mjs && node test/storage.test.mjs && node test/prune.test.mjs
